Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)

Load fishing data and preliminary analyses


Show the code
df <- as.data.frame(data.set[2]) # Landings
sp_names <- unique(df %>% dplyr::select(4)) # getting species names
sc_names <- unique(df %>% dplyr::select(5)) # getting species names
# Grouping by year and species names
summary_data <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Common_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total = sum(Landing, na.rm = TRUE),
    Scientific_name = first(Scientific_name),  # Keep the first occurrence
    .groups = 'drop') # ensures resulting dataframe is a non-grouped df
# Shortening scientific name
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(Scientific_name = gsub("^(\\w)\\w+ (.*)", "\\1. \\2", Scientific_name))
# Split the summarized data into a list, each species as a separate dataframe
species_list <- split(summary_data, summary_data$Common_name)
# Pivot the summary data to wide format
sp <- summary_data[ ,c(1,3,4)]
wide_data <- sp %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,  # Column names will be years
    values_from = Total # Values will be the total landings
  )
# Scientific name to row's
wide_data <- wide_data %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Scientific_name")
# Calculating CVs
cv_results <- sapply(1:nrow(wide_data), function(i){
  row_data <- as.numeric(wide_data[i, ])
  sd(row_data, na.rm = T)/mean(row_data, na.rm = T)*100
})
cv_df <- as.data.frame(cv_results, row.names = row.names(wide_data))
# Keep only species with CV is lower than 100
cv_n <- row.names(cv_df)[cv_df$cv_results < 100]
wide_data <- wide_data[row.names(wide_data) %in% cv_n, ]
# List comprehension to z-score normalization of data
lstls <- to_list(
  for(i in 1:nrow(wide_data)) 
    (wide_data[i,] - rowMeans(wide_data[i,], na.rm = T)) / sd(wide_data[i,])
)
data <- do.call(rbind, lstls)
ts_data <- ts(t(data))
# Plot time series to check if they were standardized
matplot(ts_data, type = "l", lty = 1, col = 1:ncol(ts_data), xaxt = "n")
axis(1, at = seq_along(ts_data[, 1]), labels =  colnames(data)) # Customize x-axis

Testing the number of optimal clusters

# Cluster evaluation ####
fix_seed <- 72 # Setting a seed ensures that any random initialization within
# the clustering process is reproducible
ks <- 2L:6L
cvi_idx <- c("D")
# ### HIERARCHICAL - DTW basic - SHAPE EXTRACTION - COMPLETE ### =============
hc <- tsclust(
  data, # wide_data, preproc = zscore,
  type = "hierarchical",
  k = ks,
  # norm = "L2", # normalization / euclidean distance
  distance = "dtw_basic",
  centroid = shape_extraction,
  centroid_args = list(znorm = FALSE),
  control = hierarchical_control(method = "complete"),
  window.size = round(ncol(data)*0.10),
  seed = fix_seed
)
names(hc) <- paste0(ks)
cvi_hc <- sapply(hc, cvi, type = cvi_idx)
# ### PAM ### =================================================================
pc_pam <- tsclust(
  data,
  type = "partitional",
  k = ks,
  distance = "dtw_basic",
  centroid = "pam",
  window.size = round(ncol(data)*0.10),
  seed = fix_seed
)
names(pc_pam) <- paste0(ks)
cvi_pc_pam <- sapply(pc_pam, cvi, type = cvi_idx)
# ### DBA ###  ================================================================
pc_dba <- tsclust(
  data,
  type = "partitional",
  k = ks,
  distance = "dtw_basic",
  centroid = "dba",
  window.size = round(ncol(data)*0.10),
  seed = fix_seed
)
names(pc_dba) <- paste0(ks)
cvi_pc_dba <- sapply(pc_dba, cvi, type = cvi_idx)
# ### Plot ### ================================================================
cvi_list <- list(cvi_hc, cvi_pc_pam, cvi_pc_dba) # Merging CVIs
cvi_list <- lapply(cvi_list, function(x) {
  x <- matrix(x, nrow = 1)
  rownames(x) <- "Dunn" # Assign the row names c(Dunn")
  colnames(x) <- ks
  return(x) # Return the modified element
})
cvi_df <- list_to_df(cvi_list,
                     legend_labels = c(
                       "Hierarchical", "Partitional PAM", "Partitional DBA"))
# Plot CVI to select best "k"

# --- as PDF

# HTML output

Dynamic Factor Analysis (DFA)

Testing the number of optimal trends


Show the code
yrs <- colnames(data)
colnames(data) <- NULL
# get number and length of time series
ts_n <- dim(data)[1]
ts_l <- dim(data)[2]
y_bar <- data # landings
dat <- as.matrix(data)
rownames(dat) <- rownames(data)
# 
set.seed(123)  # reproducibility
dfa_models <- list()
aicc_vals <- c()
ordinals <- c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th", "6th")
for (m in 1:6) {
  cat("Fitting", ordinals[m], "DFA model | ")
  dfa_models[[as.character(m)]] <- fit_dfa(m, dat, ts_n)
  aicc_vals[as.character(m)] <- dfa_models[[as.character(m)]]$AICc
  cat("--------------------------------\n")
}
best_m <- names(which.min(aicc_vals))
aicc_table <- round(data.frame(
  m = 1:6,
  AICc = aicc_vals,
  delta_AICc = aicc_vals - min(aicc_vals)),2
  )
aicc_summary <- aicc_table[ ,c(1,3)]
kable(aicc_summary, 
      col.names = c("M", "ΔAICc"),
      align = "ccc", 
      row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "DFA model selection results based on ΔAICc.") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
cat("Best model is with", best_m, "trends\n")

Getting all possible formulas

#  --- Generate all possible formulas
th <- c('25','50','75') # percentiles
response <- "y"  # generic name for response variable
glms_formulas_by_ix <- list()
for(k in 1:length(th)){
  # List of variables and index selection
  vq <- c(th[k], response)
  idx_var <- to_vec(
    for(i in 1:length(vq)) str_which(names_col, vq[i], negate = FALSE)
  )
  names_var <- c('soi','sam','enso', names_col[idx_var])
  
  #  Combinations of climate indices
  ci <- c('soi','sam','enso')
  cixs <- to_list(
    for(i in 1:length(ci)) c(combn(ci, i, simplify = FALSE))
  )
  
  cixss <- list()
  cixss[[1]] <- cixs[[2]]   # pairs
  cixss[[1]][[4]] <- unlist(cixs[[3]]) # all
  
  for(ix in 1:length(cixss[[1]])){
    cith <- paste(paste(cixss[[1]][[ix]], collapse = '|'), sep = '|')
    names_var_ix <- names_var[-grep(pattern = cith, names_var)]
    
    #  Remove percentile tag
    for(tag in th[k]) names_var_ix <- gsub(tag,'', names_var_ix)
    
    # Covariates and response
    xnames <- names_var_ix
    ynames <- response
    
    # Formulas with interactions
    inter <- c("riv", "kd", "sss")
    glms_f <- comb_glmi(xnames, ynames, inter)
    
    if(ix < length(cixss[[1]])){
      glms_f <- glms_f[grep(pattern = paste(cixss[[1]][[4]], collapse = '|'), glms_f)]
    }
    glms_formulas_by_ix[[ix]] <- glms_f
  }
}
# Combine all formulas into a single object

Getting all possible formulas

##| results: asis
th <- c('25','50','75') # percentiles
response <- "y"  # generic name for response variable
gams_formulas_by_ix <- list()
for(k in 1:length(th)){
  # List of variables and index selection
  vq <- c(th[k], response)
  idx_var <- to_vec(
    for(i in 1:length(vq)) str_which(names_col, vq[i], negate = FALSE)
  )
  names_var <- c('soi','sam','enso', names_col[idx_var])
  
  #  Combinations of climate indices
  ci <- c('soi','sam','enso')
  cixs <- to_list(
    for(i in 1:length(ci)) c(combn(ci, i, simplify = FALSE))
  )
  
  cixss <- list()
  cixss[[1]] <- cixs[[2]]   # pairs
  cixss[[1]][[4]] <- unlist(cixs[[3]]) # all
  
  for(ix in 1:length(cixss[[1]])){
    cith <- paste(paste(cixss[[1]][[ix]], collapse = '|'), sep = '|')
    names_var_ix <- names_var[-grep(pattern = cith, names_var)]
    
    #  Remove percentile tag
    for(tag in th[k]) names_var_ix <- gsub(tag,'', names_var_ix)
    
    # Covariates and response
    xnames <- names_var_ix
    ynames <- response
    
    # Formulas with interactions
    inter <- c("riv", "kd", "sss")
    gams_f <- comb_gami(xnames, ynames, 4, inter)
    
    if(ix < length(cixss[[1]])){
      gams_f <- gams_f[grep(pattern = paste(cixss[[1]][[4]], collapse = '|'), gams_f)]
    }
    gams_formulas_by_ix[[ix]] <- gams_f
  }
}
# Combine all formulas into a single object
gams_formulas <- do.call(c, gams_formulas_by_ix)
# Transform to character
# gams_formulas_chr <- sapply(
#   gams_formulas, function(f) paste(deparse(f), collapse = " ")
#   )
clean_format <- function(x) paste(format(x), collapse = "")
head_f <- sapply(head(gams_formulas, 3), clean_format)
tail_f <- sapply(tail(gams_formulas, 3), clean_format)
cat(paste(head_f, collapse = "\n\n"),
    "\n\n... and so on until... \n\n",
    paste(tail_f, collapse = "\n\n"),
    sep = ""
    )
